turns.response_html:
The reason your current script is missing people is likely due to split shifts or cells containing multiple time ranges (e.g., 9-1 / 4-9).

Your current code (str.split('-')) only looks at the first split it finds. If a cell has 9-1 / 4-9, the script sees the 1 (1:00 PM), decides it's too early, and stops looking—completely missing the 9 (9:00 PM) at the end.

Here is the updated logic. It scans the entire cell for any shift ending 8:00 PM or later.

The Fix

Replace your existing isLateShift function with this new version:

// --- UPDATED LOGIC TO CHECK TIME ---
function isLateShift(shiftString) {
  if (!shiftString) return false;
  
  // 1. Clean the string: remove letters like "F", "pm", "Justin" to avoid confusion
  //    "4-10F" becomes "4-10", "Justin (5-11-12-4)" becomes "(5-11-12-4)"
  let str = shiftString.toString().replace(/[a-zA-Z]/g, '').trim();

  // 2. Regex to find ALL time ranges (e.g., "4-10" or "5-11" or "12-4")
  //    Matches patterns like: "4-10", "4:30-10:00", "5 - 11"
  const timeRangeRegex = /(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*-\s*(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?/g;

  let match;
  // 3. Loop through EVERY time range found in the cell
  while ((match = timeRangeRegex.exec(str)) !== null) {
    // Group 3 is the End Hour, Group 4 is End Minutes
    let endHour = parseInt(match[3]);
    let endMin = match[4] ? parseInt(match[4]) : 0;

    // CHECK 1: Standard closers (9pm, 10pm, 11pm)
    if (endHour >= 9 && endHour <= 11) return true;

    // CHECK 2: Late 8pm shifts (e.g. 8:15, 8:30)
    // Note: This strictly catches "past 8". 8:00 exactly is excluded.
    if (endHour === 8 && endMin > 0) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

Why this fixes it

  1. Handles Split Shifts: If a cell contains 9-1 / 4-10, the loop checks 9-1 (Ending at 1 → No), then keeps going and checks 4-10 (Ending at 10 → Yes).
  2. Handles "Justin (5-11-12-4)":
    • It finds 5-11: Ends at 11 → Matches (Closer).
    • It finds 12-4: Ends at 4 → No.
    • Since it found at least one match, Justin is included.
  3. Handles "4-10F": The .replace(/[a-zA-Z]/g, '') strips the "F", leaving 4-10, which is parsed correctly.

Reminder

Don't forget to add the "Drive API" service in your Apps Script editor (left sidebar > Services > Drive API), or the script will fail when it tries to copy/convert the Excel file.

Here are the two most common reasons for "invisible" closers in Excel schedules:

// --- ROBUST LOGIC TO CHECK TIME ---
function isLateShift(shiftString) {
  if (!shiftString) return false;
  
  // 1. Convert to string and lowercase
  let str = shiftString.toString().toLowerCase();

  // 2. IMMEDIATE CATCH: If it says "cl", "close", or "closing", it's a closer.
  if (str.includes('cl') || str.includes('close')) return true;

  // 3. Normalize "Fancy Dashes" (Excel often uses en-dash '–' instead of hyphen '-')
  //    We replace them all with a standard minus sign.
  str = str.replace(/[–—]/g, '-');

  // 4. Remove all remaining letters to clean up (e.g. "4-10pm" -> "4-10")
  str = str.replace(/[a-z]/g, '').trim();

  // 5. Regex to find ALL time ranges
  //    Matches: "4-10", "4:30-10", "5 - 11", etc.
  const timeRangeRegex = /(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*-\s*(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?/g;

  let match;
  while ((match = timeRangeRegex.exec(str)) !== null) {
    // Group 3 is End Hour, Group 4 is End Minutes
    let endHour = parseInt(match[3]);
    let endMin = match[4] ? parseInt(match[4]) : 0;

    // CHECK 1: Ends at 9, 10, or 11
    if (endHour >= 9 && endHour <= 11) return true;

    // CHECK 2: Ends past 8:00 (e.g. 8:15, 8:30)
    // Note: This excludes exactly 8:00. If you want 8:00 included, change to `endMin >= 0`
    if (endHour === 8 && endMin > 0) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

function saveFarewayExcelsToSubfolder() {
  // --- CONFIGURATION ---

// --- FUNCTION TO FIND CLOSERS (ACROSS ALL TABS) ---
function checkFridayClosers(fileId, emailAddress) {
  try {
    let excelFile = DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);
    
    // 1. Convert Excel to Temp Sheet
    let config = {
      title: "[TEMP] Schedule Parsing",
      parents: [{id: excelFile.getParents().next().getId()}],
      mimeType: MimeType.GOOGLE_SHEETS
    };
    
    // Convert is CRITICAL
    let tempFile = Drive.Files.copy(config, fileId, {convert: true}); 
    let ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(tempFile.id);
    let sheets = ss.getSheets(); // GET ALL TABS

    let allClosers = [];

    // 2. LOOP THROUGH EVERY TAB (Full Time, Checkers, Produce, etc.)
    sheets.forEach(sheet => {
      let sheetName = sheet.getName();
      let data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
      
      // Skip empty sheets
      if (data.length < 2) return;

      // 3. DYNAMICALLY FIND "FRIDAY" COLUMN
      // We look at the first 5 rows to find the word "Friday"
      let fridayColIndex = -1;
      let nameColIndex = 0; // Assume Name is always Column A (0)

      for (let r = 0; r < 5 && r < data.length; r++) {
        for (let c = 0; c < data[r].length; c++) {
          if (data[r][c] && data[r][c].toString().toLowerCase().includes("friday")) {
            fridayColIndex = c;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (fridayColIndex !== -1) break;
      }

      // If "Friday" not found, default to Column F (Index 5) as fallback
      if (fridayColIndex === -1) fridayColIndex = 5;

      // 4. SCAN ROWS
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
        let row = data[i];
        // Safety check: ensure row has enough columns
        if (row.length <= fridayColIndex) continue;

        let name = row[nameColIndex];
        let shift = row[fridayColIndex]; 

        // Skip rows with no name or headers like "Full-Time"
        if (!name || name.toString().includes("Full-Time") || name.toString().includes("Monday")) continue;

        if (isLateShift(shift)) {
          // Format: "Name (TabName): Shift"
          allClosers.push(`${name} (${sheetName}): ${shift}`);
        }
      }
    });

    // 5. Send Email
    if (allClosers.length > 0) {
      let subject = `Friday Closers: ${excelFile.getName()}`;
      let body = `The following employees are closing (working past 8:00 PM) on Friday:\n\n` + allClosers.join("\n");
      MailApp.sendEmail(emailAddress, subject, body);
      Logger.log(`📧 Email sent to ${emailAddress} with ${allClosers.length} closers.`);
    } else {
      Logger.log("No late closers found.");
    }

    // 6. Cleanup
    DriveApp.getFileById(tempFile.id).setTrashed(true);

  } catch (e) {
    Logger.log(`Error reading schedule: ${e.message}`);
  }
}

// --- LOGIC TO CHECK TIME (Supports "CL", "4-10", "4-10pm") ---
function isLateShift(shiftString) {
  if (!shiftString) return false;
  
  let str = shiftString.toString().toLowerCase();

  // 1. Immediate catch for "Close" text
  if (str.includes('cl') || str.includes('close')) return true;

  // 2. Normalize dashes
  str = str.replace(/[–—]/g, '-');
  // 3. Remove letters
  str = str.replace(/[a-z]/g, '').trim();

  // 4. Regex for time ranges
  const timeRangeRegex = /(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*-\s*(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?/g;

  let match;
  while ((match = timeRangeRegex.exec(str)) !== null) {
    let endHour = parseInt(match[3]);
    let endMin = match[4] ? parseInt(match[4]) : 0;

    // Logic: Ends at 9, 10, 11 OR ends past 8:00
    if ((endHour >= 9 && endHour <= 11) || (endHour === 8 && endMin > 0)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}
